ICE procurement papers reveal plans for mobile detention vans to expand field arrest capacities.
Evidence: Government documents, private contracts, missing standards
#Aletheia #Immigration #ICE

Officials frame expanded detention infrastructure as necessary administrative logistics to maintain public safety and lawful order.

Deploying unregulated mobile vans for human detention bypasses basic humanitarian standards and accelerates mass enforcement unchecked.

When human processing is industrialized without basic legal and sanitary standards, administrative efficiency masks cruelty.

Integrity: Severe Deception (Hypocrisy: 16.8, z: 3)

- ICE Procurement: FAIL (-0.9, -0.9) — Seeks unregulated mobile detention.

Watchdog groups like Project Salt Box are actively exposing buried procurement documents and tracking facility standards.

The Breakdown & Plane Error:
Confusing WHERE (operational logistics of transport) with WHO (accountability for human rights), substituting administrative metrics for basic dignity.

The Unavoidable Truth: Mobile detention units lack fundamental regulatory oversight and hygiene standards.

The Unavoidable Lie: Expedited processing vans ensure humane treatment.
